concept.hr: Tko drži oba dijela para može pogriješiti i sakriti; malom timu treba kontrola
concept.en: Whoever holds both halves can err and hide it; a small team needs a control

summary.hr: Dodijeli dužnosti timu od 3 do 12 ljudi, prati sukobe na matrici, razdvoji ih, dodaj kontrolu ili prihvati potpisom; smanjuj tim dok se više ne može razdvojiti.
summary.en: Assign duties in a team of 3 to 12, watch conflicts light up on the matrix, split them, add a control or sign them off; shrink the team until separation fails.
